sellThenNews.description: r/wallstreetbets 2026 年 7 月 8 日情绪分析。讨论最多的股票代码：MU、SPCX、SPY、NVDA、AVGO。人工智能生成的零售流程、牛市/熊市叙述和关键主题的摘要。

sections.overview:
1. 整体市场概况和情绪

今日主要事件：

  • Trump declared the Iran ceasefire "over" and threatened to strike again tonight: At the NATO summit in Ankara, Trump said the temporary agreement with Iran was "over," that negotiations were a "waste of time," revoked Iran oil waivers, restarted sanctions, and warned that he could resume a naval blockade and "take" Kharg Island. Explosions were reported at oil ports including Kharg Island, Bandar Abbas, and Qeshm. Markets immediately turned red across the board: SPY was at 741.26 (-0.87%), having briefly touched an intraday low of 739.55, hugging the 740 level the community has been obsessively watching; QQQ 703.57 (-0.83%), DIA -1.42%, IWM -1.55%, with small and mid caps leading the decline.
  • Oil prices surged while precious metals collapsed: Brent jumped about 3% overnight, and USO is currently +4.80%, with the community joking that "black gold" is back; but safe-haven GLD -1.85% and SLV -4.55% both sold off sharply, while safe-haven flows instead poured into the dollar (DXY strengthened), leaving the community confused.
  • FOMC minutes today at 14:00 (June meeting): Because Chair Warsh deliberately did not submit a dot plot, these minutes have become the only official record of the committee’s stance on whether to hike rates in September, making them unusually important. The committee is split 9:9 on whether to hike in 2026; the probability of a September hike is around 50-55%, and the Iran incident has pushed up short-term hike bets, with Treasury yields jumping. The community broadly expects the minutes to lean hawkish.
  • Nvidia China positive news, but the market largely ignored it: The Information reported that China plans to allow Alibaba, ByteDance, DeepSeek, and others to buy a "small amount" of H200 chips (possibly fewer than 200 thousand units). NVDA bucked the trend at +0.31% (touching 199.86), becoming the only green pillar in a sea of red across semiconductors, but the community mocked the news for lasting only a few minutes before being sold back down.
  • Violent volatility in semiconductors/memory: MU violently V-shaped from 902 at the open to 958, then fell back to 921.99 (-1.88%) now, repeatedly rejected in the 915-924 range; SNDK spiked to 1700 before closing flat at 1613 (-0.29%). AVGO strengthened independently at +4.18% (Apple order narrative). INTC plunged -4.71% (105), down -25% in a single week this month.
  • Geopolitical spillover: Trump also said he would terminate all trade with Spain, calling it a "terrible NATO ally," further weighing on risk sentiment.

社区氛围：整体基调是看跌混乱，混合着疲惫和黑色幽默——在V形开盘后，多头反复受到“假V”的教训，社区称每次反弹都是牛市陷阱（“今天的第383次”）。许多玩家转而加入现金帮，宣布本周退出，并发送垃圾邮件“结束了/joever”，尽管内心深处仍然存在一种反射性的看涨本能，即他“必须吃玉米饼并取消罢工”。

恐惧/贪婪：有恐惧倾向，但不极端。实际的市场走势只有-1%左右，但社区里充斥着哀嚎和损失色情，情绪相对于实际下跌明显放大——多条高票评论自嘲称“只下跌了2%，但感觉像是10%”和“因为连续两周都是红色，所以更痛苦”。

情绪与现实：社区将“我的记忆股票是绿色的”视为大盘是绿色的，而实际上指数都是红色的；与此同时，他们将 -0.87% 的 SPY 举动描述为“世界末日/-90%”，这种对比本身就成为了当天最大的模因。实际行情是低波动性、窄幅拉锯战，紧紧锁定在 740 点上方，与评论中戏剧性的“街头血腥”叙述截然不同。

5. 个股情绪分析

股票行情指示器提及牛/熊情绪核心视图摘要
MUHigh看跌开盘从902→958剧烈V形后回落，在915-924反复被拒绝，守不住900； “12天内的每一次反弹都创下了新低”，而三星的节拍+扎克抛售内存则助长了“内存代运行已结束/新一代囊袋持有者”的论调；多头坚称超卖反弹不可避免，内存短缺持续存在，但 AH 波动性如此之高，以至于许多人接受了损失并退出
NVDAHigh中性至看涨半导体大屠杀中唯一的绿色支柱，接近但未能突破200；中国将允许购买H200的积极消息被市场忽视，“上涨了几分钟，然后又被猛烈回击”；社区开玩笑说“NVDA一变红，SPY的生命线就断了”，将其视为市场的稳定锚；被称为“多汁”的看跌期权与300个价格目标并存
